cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll forgive the argument if you come to my opening. Please put it in your diary now; an intention isn't an arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I work that night. I could help hang the paintings on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a useful substitution. Write down Sunday, ten o'clock. Hanging buys forgiveness; taking them down buys an end to my mentioning it to Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll do both, but you have to tell Mum we sorted it out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please distinguish not mentioning the argument from telling Mum it's settled. Return the borrowed easels as well, and I'll ring her while you load them.
